tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches products available at local Calgary stores. Returns product name, store, price, stock level and store categories.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Returns the live stock level of one product, optionally for a single store.

tools.name: get_todays_deals
tools.description: Returns today's discounted products and active flash deals at local stores, with sale and regular prices.

tools.name: get_stores
tools.description: Returns local Calgary stores with their location information.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Places an order for one product from a BuyNearby store. Creates a real order; the customer receives a payment link by text or email, the card is held and is only charged after the store confirms the order. Guests provide name, phone and email; signed-in customers' saved details are used.

tools.name: place_cart_order
tools.description: Places one order for several products from one or more BuyNearby stores. Prices and stock come from the live catalog. Creates a real order; the customer receives a payment link by text or email, the card is held and is only charged after the store confirms the order. Delivery or pickup.

tools.name: book_courier
tools.description: Gets a quote for, books, checks the status of, or cancels a point-to-point courier delivery in Calgary. tools.name: shop_and_deliver
tools.description: Books a personal shopping run: a BuyNearby driver shops the given item list at a named store and delivers it. Creates a real order; the customer is charged the driver's actual receipt total afterward. Item prices given are estimates.
